column_description: A CHAR(12) primary key for each content behavior record (e.g., 'CB1234567890').
An enum (ContentLanguageCount_enum) showing language count in posts (1, 2, 3, 4, or 5).
An enum (HashtagUsagePattern_enum) describing hashtag usage (Trending, Normal, Random, Spam).
NUMERIC(3,2) fraction of posts with at least one hashtag (e.g., '0.23').
An enum (MentionPattern_enum) describing mention usage (Normal, Random, Targeted, Spam).
NUMERIC(5,3) fraction of posts with mentions (e.g., '0.568').
A VARCHAR(24) showing how often URLs are shared (e.g., 'HighFreq').
NUMERIC(4,2) domain diversity among shared URLs (e.g., '1.23').
NUMERIC(5,3) fraction of posts including media (e.g., '0.345').
NUMERIC(6,4) how often the same media is reused (e.g., '0.2345').
